description: Final refit vs original benchmark comparison for Dataset A Part 2 written premium modeling. Model selection is complete and locked on 2013-2014 holdout results. This file documents the all-data (2006-2014) refit artifacts against the locked 2006-2012 benchmark models for the three selected specifications.

modeling_context.excluded_years_reason: Partial reporting years: MONTHS avg < 12 and/or material decline in row count and agency coverage
modeling_context.effective_row_filter: Additional 709 rows (546 train, 163 test) excluded from all models due to NA in log_prev_wp or log_prev_poly — rare accounting-adjustment rows with negative PREV_ values
modeling_context.final_refit_purpose: Deployment-style artifact — expands training data to include 2013-2014 after model selection was locked on those years as holdout
modeling_context.validation_note: Final refit in-sample and OOB metrics are diagnostic only. The original 2013-2014 holdout metrics remain the sole model-selection basis and official evaluation evidence.

candidate_predictors_tested_and_rejected: PREV_LOSS_RATIO (delta test R2 = 0.0000 on population-controlled comparison, coverage 91.2%)
PREV_RETENTION_RATIO (delta test R2 = +0.0009 on population-controlled comparison, coverage 37.8% — PL only)
exclusion_notes.cluster_feature_excluded: AGENCY_CLUSTER (k=50 agency clustering yielded delta seen-agency test R2 = -0.0016, below 0.005 threshold)

benchmark_summary.model_selection_basis: 2013-2014 holdout R², RMSE, and MAE on n=30,981 effective test rows
benchmark_summary.final_refit_purpose: All three models retrained on 2006-2014 eligible rows for deployment and interpretability artifacts. Model selection is locked.
benchmark_summary.warning: Final refit in-sample and OOB metrics are NOT holdout validation metrics. They are diagnostic artifacts for confirming specification stability after expanding the training window.

original_fit.formula: log_wp ~ log_prev_wp + log_prev_poly + ACTIVE_PRODUCERS + AGENCY_APPOINTMENT_YEAR + MAX_AGE + MIN_AGE + STATE_ABBR + PROD_ABBR + VENDOR + STAT_PROFILE_DATE_YEAR

final_refit.metric_type: in-sample diagnostic — all 2006-2014 training rows used; no holdout
final_refit.oob_note: Not applicable — OLS has no OOB mechanism

comparison.comparison_type: final all-data in-sample vs original 2006-2012 training in-sample
comparison.apples_to_apples_note: Both metrics are in-sample, but computed on different training populations (2006-2012 vs 2006-2014). Directionally comparable; not a strict holdout comparison.

comparison_notes: Final all-data in-sample metrics (R²=0.7809, RMSE=1.0267, MAE=0.6523) are diagnostic only. Original 2013-2014 holdout metrics are the locked evaluation evidence.
Delta R² = -0.0001 between the two training windows indicates a highly stable OLS specification with no structural shift from including 2013-2014.
Small RMSE and MAE increases (+0.0029, +0.0055) are consistent with marginally higher residual variance in the 2006-2014 population vs 2006-2012 only.
OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL_ALL_DATA is a reference/interpretability artifact. RF_FINAL_ALL_DATA is the primary deployment model.

hyperparameters.seed_note: Seed not recorded for original tuning run

tuning_grid.selection_note: RF_1_SAFE_TUNED selected as minimum OOB RMSE model from 48-model grid

original_fit.original_oob_mae_note: OOB MAE not reported by ranger

hyperparameters.hyperparameter_note: Identical to RF_1_SAFE_TUNED; seed=42 added for reproducibility of the all-data refit

final_refit.metric_type_in_sample: in-sample diagnostic — all 2006-2014 training rows used; no holdout
final_refit.metric_type_oob: OOB diagnostic — preferred for RF refit; NOT a holdout metric
final_refit.final_refit_oob_mae_note: OOB MAE not reported by ranger

comparison.primary_comparison: OOB R²/RMSE — preferred because OOB is a natural internal validation mechanism for RF; in-sample RF metrics reflect extreme memorisation and are not meaningful alone
comparison.apples_to_apples_note: OOB comparison is the closest available apples-to-apples diagnostic for RF without a holdout; both OOB metrics are computed on the respective training populations.

comparison_notes: Final RF OOB metrics (R²=0.9000, RMSE=0.6935) are diagnostic only and do NOT replace the locked 2013-2014 holdout metrics (test R²=0.8839, RMSE=0.7532, MAE=0.4428).
OOB R² improves marginally from 0.8989 to 0.9000 (+0.0011) with expanded training data — consistent with expected benefit from a larger training window and no indication of degradation.
OOB RMSE improves from 0.6955 to 0.6935 (-0.0020), consistent directionally with the OOB R² improvement.
Hyperparameters are identical to RF_1_SAFE_TUNED; only seed=42 is added for the all-data refit for reproducibility.
OOB MAE is not reported by ranger for either fit and is therefore null.
RF_FINAL_ALL_DATA is the primary deployment artifact.

original_fit.formula: log_wp ~ log_prev_wp + log_prev_poly + ACTIVE_PRODUCERS + AGENCY_APPOINTMENT_YEAR + MAX_AGE + MIN_AGE + STATE_ABBR + PROD_ABBR + VENDOR + STAT_PROFILE_DATE_YEAR + (1 | AGENCY_ID)

convergence_warnings: Some predictor variables are on very different scales: consider rescaling. You may also use (g)lmerControl(autoscale = TRUE) to improve numerical stability.
final_refit.convergence_note: optimizer reported converged=FALSE alongside the scale warning. singular=FALSE confirms the agency random effect variance is non-degenerate (0.341073). The warning reflects numerical scaling, not a model failure, but predictor rescaling should be applied before production deployment.
final_refit.metric_type: in-sample diagnostic — all 2006-2014 training rows used; no holdout; LMM has no OOB mechanism
final_refit.oob_note: Not applicable — LMM has no OOB mechanism

comparison.comparison_type: final all-data in-sample vs original 2006-2012 training in-sample (conditional and marginal separately)
comparison.apples_to_apples_note: Both metrics are in-sample, but computed on different training populations. No OOB mechanism exists for LMMs. Directionally comparable as a stability diagnostic.

comparison_notes: Final LMM in-sample metrics are diagnostic only. Original 2013-2014 holdout metrics (conditional: R²=0.7607, RMSE=1.0814; marginal: R²=0.7345, RMSE=1.1389) are the locked evaluation evidence.
Conditional in-sample performance is nearly identical to original training metrics (delta R² = -0.0007, delta RMSE = +0.0042), confirming a stable fixed-effects specification with expanded data.
Marginal deltas are similarly negligible (delta R² = -0.0003, delta RMSE = +0.0034), indicating no material change in the fixed-effects-only fit quality.
Agency ICC increases from 0.2422 to 0.2632 (+0.0210), reflecting additional agency-level heterogeneity captured when 2013-2014 is included as training data.
Agency group count increases from 1254 to 1334 (+80 agencies) — the 2013-2014 years include agencies not present in the 2006-2012 training window.

The all-data LMM fit reports converged=FALSE alongside a scale-mismatch warning. singular=FALSE confirms the random effect is not degenerate. The scale warning should be resolved via predictor rescaling before production deployment.
AGENCY_LMM_FULL is a structural diagnostic model. RF_1_SAFE_TUNED outperforms the best LMM conditional test metric by +0.1232 R² (0.8839 - 0.7607).

report_ready_findings: RF_FINAL_ALL_DATA is the primary deployment artifact. Official holdout evidence comes from RF_1_SAFE_TUNED evaluated on 2013-2014 (n=30,981 effective rows): test R²=0.8839, RMSE=0.7532, MAE=0.4428.
All final refit metrics — OLS in-sample, RF OOB, and LMM in-sample — are diagnostic only and do not replace the locked 2013-2014 holdout evidence that determined model selection.
OLS specification is stable across training windows: in-sample R² shifts by only -0.0001 (0.7810 → 0.7809) when training expands from 2006-2012 to 2006-2014, with negligible RMSE and MAE changes.

RF OOB diagnostics from the all-data refit (OOB R²=0.9000, RMSE=0.6935) track closely with the original tuned model's OOB (R²=0.8989, RMSE=0.6955), confirming no degradation and marginal benefit from the larger training population.
LMM agency ICC increases from 0.2422 (2006-2012) to 0.2632 (2006-2014) with 80 additional agencies, consistent with capturing incremental agency-level heterogeneity over the longer training window.

The all-data LMM refit reports converged=FALSE with a predictor-scale warning (singular=FALSE). This is a numerical stability advisory — the random effect variance is non-degenerate — but predictor rescaling should be applied before production deployment of the LMM artifact.
